# INVERT

> INVERT is a research and product brand helping self-directed investors build investment judgment that compounds with every decision.

Canonical website: https://invertagent.com/
Chinese website: https://invertagent.com/zh/
Operator: Rebecca (independent developer)
Contact: privacy@invertagent.com
Updated: 2026-08-01

## Core pages

- [Home](https://invertagent.com/): Brand purpose, north star, flagship product and current publishing routes.
- [Products](https://invertagent.com/products/): INVERT App, Foresight Loop and Morning Brief with explicit status.
- [INVERT Journal](https://invertagent.com/journal/): Selected investment thinking, AI-native practice and product-building notes.
- [Morning Brief](https://invertagent.com/projects/morning-brief/): Open-source, self-hosted workflow with requirements and installation instructions.
- [For Agents](https://invertagent.com/agents/): Capability model, public contracts and current catalog.
- [About](https://invertagent.com/about/): Mission, vision, north star, research disciplines and operator.

## Current truth

- No public INVERT API or MCP endpoint is live today.
- INVERT App is a private alpha, not a public self-serve product.
- Morning Brief is public source code for a self-hosted workflow, not a hosted API or one-click plugin.
- Planned capabilities are research candidates, not availability claims.
- INVERT is not a broker, fund, registered investment adviser or automated trading service.
- Public materials are research and educational information, not individualized investment advice.
- Search and user-request crawlers are allowed. GPTBot and ClaudeBot are disallowed for training.
